samir: VoltChip asked for a compact perf/W publishable package. We need a strict tile number and a longer blog.

tara: Proposed for tile: mean perf/W >= 12 tokens/s/W, steady tokens/s >= 10k/rack, p99 <= 280ms. Need 3 runs, PDU wall watts, kernel commit hash.

leo: I'll run the 3-run suite on Rack-D tomorrow AM. Kernel tweak (stride+prefetch) in branch sprefetch-1. Will post commit hash and CSVs.

leo: ```
# quick reproduce
bench --model=redwood-10b --seq=512 --warmup=180 --steady=300 --runs=3 \n  --collect=tokens_per_s,p99,pdu_watts --kernel=sprefetch-1 \n  --out=artifacts/voltchip-d.csv
```

voltchip-qa: We'll join the Tue 8am PT call and provide rack spec + 16:9 hero. Note: PDUs report aggregated wall watts; include wiring note.

ops-bot: Created LEGAL-904. Estimated review 48h. Calendar invite sent for Tue 8am PT cross-org smoke.

samir: Marketing: tile will show conservative verified numbers. Blog can explain kernel uplift. Tara: please draft tile copy and "how we tested" blurb.

tara: Will do. Action items: leo run sweeps + paste CSVs (due Mon 2pm PT), voltchip-qa send rack assets (due Mon EOD), ops-bot legal ticket (done).

samir: If perf/W target missed but kernel shows consistent uplift vs baseline, we can include a "coming soon" note in the blog, not the tile.

leo: Copy. Running local smoke now, will post preview shortly. :mechanical_arm:
